source.query_description: For single games, from 2018 to 2024, started the game, played QB, in the regular season or the postseason, sorted by descending Date.
source.acquisition_method: User-authenticated manual Stathead export and manual paginated CSV capture.
source.citation_note: Sports Reference requests attribution/citation when using its data.

verified_uploaded_source.format: HTML table exported with .xls extension by Stathead
verified_uploaded_source.durable_repo_status: Deterministic extracted CSV is committed; original uploaded HTML bytes are fingerprinted here but are not yet stored as a repository file.

extracted_artifact.pfr_player_id_extraction: HTML name_display cell data-append-csv attribute -> Player-additional
normalization_notes: The displayed Stathead game_result HTML uses a comma after W/L/T; the derived CSV removes that single display comma to match Stathead CSV-export field shape.
No starter adjudication, deduplication, BYE removal, canonical-game matching, or identity correction is performed in this extraction.

full_source_expectation.known_historical_capture_status: The complete ranks 1-3921 were manually captured during the Stathead acquisition session, but not all exact row text remains machine-readable in the current execution context.
full_source_expectation.status_note: Do not claim the complete 1-3921 source export is frozen until every rank is durably serialized from exact source text or equivalent uploaded exports.

known_source_quality_notes: The raw Stathead query output contains known false-positive/non-QB-starter rows, including BYE rows and multiple QB-classified started rows for some team-games.
Raw row count 3921 must not be reduced to the expected 3884 accepted game-side starters by arbitrary deletion; canonical reconciliation and explicit ambiguity handling are required.
holdout_guardrail: The 2025 NFL season remains sealed. Calendar-date Jan/Feb 2025 postseason rows that belong to the 2024 NFL season are allowed development-period records; no 2025 NFL-season starter/performance data is authorized.
immutability: Raw/source-preservation artifacts are immutable. Cleaning/integration must create new derived files and leave existing historical 2018-2024 datasets intact.
